items.title: Stunt performers
items.body: Registered performers for falls, fights, wire work, driving and body-hazard sequences, working to the stunt coordinator's brief.

items.title: Stunt doubles
items.body: Doubles matched to your lead on height, build, colouring and movement, so the cut holds when the action takes over.

items.title: Fight-trained performers
items.body: Actors and performers with genuine combat training — screen fighting, martial arts and weapons — who can act the scene as well as land it.

items.title: Action extras & crowd
items.body: Background who can take physical direction: reactions, falls, scrambles and crowd action that reads without endangering anyone.

approach.heading: Safety is the schedule
approach.body: Every stunt booking runs through your stunt coordinator, not around them. We supply people whose training, registration and recent experience match what the sequence actually asks for, we are straightforward about what a performer can and cannot do, and we would rather tell you a name is wrong than watch a day fall apart on the floor. Nobody on our books is put forward for action they are not cleared for.

points.description: Height, build, colouring and movement checked against your cast before a name is sent, not after.
Training, registration and recent credits confirmed for the specific sequence being cast.
We work to your stunt coordinator's brief and keep them in the loop from first name to call sheet.
